changelog:
goofish-search v2.1.0 introduces an advanced, fully automated workflow for reliable Xianyu/Goofish product search, filtering, and results output.

- Now automatically filters out merchants, "multi-price", recycling ads, notebook/box listings, and non-personal sellers
- Supports precise price, region, condition, and sorting controls; applies ascending price sort by default
- Implements robust, tested multi-page scraping with browser typing & clicking, ensuring accurate results even if Goofish's DOM changes
- Outputs a detailed, structured Markdown summary with product stats and direct links, saved to desktop for easy access
- Enhanced reliability and relevance versus similar skills, prioritizing trustworthy personal second-hand listings only
display_name: 闲鱼快速检索 Goofish Search
summary: Use when user wants to search Xianyu/Goofish for products. Auto-search, filter merchants, sort by price, and output TOP results.
